notes_for_editor: The thinnest of the three. The Forest Lookouts page for Carter Top has only a heading and a county line; the state-list entry has coordinates only. Two web searches and the cached pages gave no agency, build date, design or status. The anyplaceamerica summit and tower pages returned HTTP 403 and were not read. Needs a Forest Fire Lookout Association or NHLR record, or a site visit, before the story can say more. Check whether the Jackson County Forest Service office or a local history source mentions a tower on Carter Top.
